subject: [hw] P03 start: client library, transports, phone hw back end, CLI
body: Reading PLAN/TASK/include. I own gpu/hwcodec/client/** only. Deliverables: n2vc_hw_dev.c (RWVC_* ioctls), n2vcd_transport.c (relay + SOCK_SEQPACKET with handle-named buffer files) + n2vcd_server.h helpers for hw-ip, n2vcd_client.[ch], n2vcd_cli.c, tests with a scripted fake server. Questions I will post separately to hw-ip/hw-t02 about buffer-file naming and server helper shape.
